job.job_title: Lead LLM / Agentic AI Engineer - AI-Led Procurement Transformation
job.job_description:
Location: Kolkata
Experience: 8+ Years
Budget: Up to 3 Lakh/month
Work Mode: Onsite / Client-facing
Travel: May be required
Cloud: AWS preferred / important

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Lead LLM / Agentic AI Engineer to lead an AI-led transformation initiative for the Procurement function.

The candidate will design and develop a Procurement Category Insights Engine combining Classical Machine Learning, Statistical Modelling, LLMs, Generative AI and Agentic AI.

This is not a basic chatbot or RAG development role. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building production-grade Multi-Agent AI solutions, integrating real-time and external data sources, APIs, ERP/enterprise systems, and deploying scalable AI applications.

The role requires someone who can take a business problem from:

Business Problem AI Architecture Multi-Agent Solution Enterprise Integration Production Deployment Client Handover

Key Responsibilities

Lead architecture and development of enterprise-grade LLM, GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

Design and implement Multi-Agent AI workflows capable of reasoning, planning and executing multi-step tasks.

Build and orchestrate specialized AI agents for procurement-related use cases.

Design agent workflows, state management, tool calling and API integrations.

Develop the Procurement Category Insights Engine using ML, statistical modelling and GenAI.

Integrate internal, external and real-time data sources.

Integrate AI solutions with ERP and enterprise applications.

Build tools/API layers that enable agents to retrieve information and perform approved business actions.

Develop RAG-based solutions for enterprise knowledge and contextual understanding.

Implement prompt engineering, agent instructions, guardrails and evaluation mechanisms.

Implement LLM monitoring, evaluation and performance optimization.

Integrate classical ML/statistical models with GenAI applications.

Work closely with Data Scientists, Backend Engineers and Frontend Engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.

Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable and production-ready.

Lead technical discussions with client stakeholders.

Support testing, deployment, documentation and client handover.

Required Technical SkillsGenerative AI / LLM

8+ years of overall experience in Software Engineering / AI / ML.

Strong hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI.

Experience developing and deploying production-grade GenAI applications.

Strong understanding of LLM architecture, prompting and model selection.

Experience with commercial and/or open-source LLMs.

Strong experience with RAG architectures.

Experience with embeddings and Vector Databases.

Agentic AI

Strong hands-on experience building Agentic AI solutions.

Proven experience with Multi-Agent Orchestration.

Hands-on experience with one or more:

LangGraph

LangChain

AutoGen

CrewAI

Equivalent Agentic AI frameworks

Experience designing agent workflows and state management.

Strong understanding of tool calling / function calling.

Experience building agents that interact with APIs, databases and enterprise systems.

Experience implementing agent guardrails and evaluation mechanisms.

Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling

Strong foundation in classical Machine Learning.

Strong understanding of statistics and statistical modelling.

Experience integrating predictive ML models with GenAI applications.

Strong Python programming skills.

Experience with common ML libraries and frameworks.

Enterprise Integration

Experience integrating AI solutions with ERP and enterprise applications.

Strong REST API and microservices experience.

Experience consuming external and real-time data sources.

Experience developing APIs/tools for AI agents.

Understanding of enterprise security, authentication and access controls.

Cloud & Engineering

Strong hands-on Python development.

Strong software engineering and system-design fundamentals.

Experience with AWS-based AI/ML architectures.

AWS Bedrock experience is highly preferred.

Experience with APIs, microservices and scalable backend systems.

Understanding of Docker/containerization and CI/CD.

Experience deploying AI solutions into production environments.

Good to Have

Procurement / Source-to-Pay / Supply Chain domain experience.

Procurement analytics or category intelligence experience.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) experience.

Real-time event/data processing.

AWS Bedrock or similar managed GenAI platforms.

Kafka or other streaming technologies.

LLM observability and evaluation platforms.

SAP, Oracle or other ERP integration experience.

Consulting or client-facing transformation experience.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect who can independently design and build a complete Agentic AI solution.

The candidate should have experience in:

Classical ML + Statistical Modelling + LLM + RAG + Multi-Agent AI + Enterprise APIs + Cloud + Production Deployment

Candidates with only Prompt Engineering, basic ChatGPT/API integration or simple RAG chatbot development will not be suitable.

Candidates Not to Prioritize

Basic ChatGPT/API integration profiles.

Prompt Engineers without strong software engineering experience.

Candidates with only simple RAG chatbot projects.

Candidates without Multi-Agent experience.

Candidates without production GenAI implementation experience.

Pure Data Scientists without hands-on GenAI engineering.

Candidates without API/enterprise integration experience.

Technology Split

50% - Classical ML / Statistical Modelling / Analytics
50% - LLM / Generative AI / Agentic AI

The LLM/Agentic AI component is particularly critical for this position.

Key Success Criteria

The selected candidate should be able to build a production-ready solution capable of:

Consuming internal, external and real-time data.

Understanding procurement context.

Generating category-level business insights.

Reasoning across multiple information sources.

Invoking appropriate tools and APIs.

Integrating with ERP and enterprise systems.

Recommending or initiating approved business processes.

Providing users with a simple and actionable experience.

Required Skills

Python | LLM | Generative AI | Agentic AI | Multi-Agent Systems | LangGraph | LangChain | AutoGen | CrewAI | RAG | Vector DB | Machine Learning | Statistical Modelling | REST APIs | AWS | AWS Bedrock | Tool Calling | Enterprise Integration | ERP | Microservices

Work Location & Engagement

Location: Kolkata

Work Mode: Onsite / Client-facing

Experience: 8+ Years

Budget: Up to 3 Lakh/month

Travel: May be required

AWS: Preferred / Important
